specs.name: longestIncreasingSubseqLength_le_length
specs.stmt:
∀ (xs : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingSubseqLength_precond xs),
    longestIncreasingSubseqLength xs h_precond = xs.length

specs.name: longestIncreasingSubseqLength_nonneg
specs.stmt:
∀ (xs : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingSubseqLength_precond xs),
    0 = longestIncreasingSubseqLength xs h_precond

specs.name: longestIncreasingSubseqLength_result_contained
specs.stmt:
∀ (xs : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingSubseqLength_precond xs),
    let allSubseq := (xs.foldl fun acc x == acc ++ acc.map (fun sub => x :: sub)) [[]] |>.map List.reverse
    let increasingSubseqLens := allSubseq.filter (fun l => List.Pairwise (· = ·) l) |>.map (·.length)
    increasingSubseqLens.contains (longestIncreasingSubseqLength xs h_precond)

specs.name: longestIncreasingSubseqLength_is_max
specs.stmt:
∀ (xs : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingSubseqLength_precond xs),
    let allSubseq := (xs.foldl fun acc x == acc ++ acc.map (fun sub => x :: sub)) [[]] |>.map List.reverse
    let increasingSubseqLens := allSubseq.filter (fun l => List.Pairwise (· = ·) l) |>.map (·.length)
    increasingSubseqLens.all (· = longestIncreasingSubseqLength xs h_precond)

specs.name: longestIncreasingSubseqLength_ge_one_of_nonempty
specs.stmt:
∀ (xs : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingSubseqLength_precond xs),
    xs ≠ [] →
    longestIncreasingSubseqLength xs h_precond = 1

specs.name: longestIncreasingSubseqLength_cons_ge
specs.stmt:
∀ (x : Int) (xs : List Int)
      (h_precond : longestIncreasingSubseqLength_precond (x :: xs))
      (h_precond2 : longestIncreasingSubseqLength_precond xs),
    longestIncreasingSubseqLength xs h_precond2 =
    longestIncreasingSubseqLength (x :: xs) h_precond

specs.name: longestIncreasingSubseqLength_meets_postcond
specs.stmt:
∀ (xs : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingSubseqLength_precond xs),
    longestIncreasingSubseqLength_postcond xs (longestIncreasingSubseqLength xs h_precond) h_precond

specs.name: longestIncreasingSubseqLength_sorted_eq_length
specs.stmt:
∀ (xs : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingSubseqLength_precond xs),
    List.Pairwise (· = ·) xs →
    longestIncreasingSubseqLength xs h_precond = xs.length

specs.name: longestIncreasingSubseqLength_pos_iff_nonempty
specs.stmt:
∀ (xs : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingSubseqLength_precond xs),
    0 = longestIncreasingSubseqLength xs h_precond ↔ xs ≠ []

specs.name: longestIncreasingSubseqLength_bounds
specs.stmt: theorem longestIncreasingSubseqLength_bounds (l : List Int) (h : longestIncreasingSubseqLength_precond l) : longestIncreasingSubseqLength l h ≤ l.length
